title: A green approach to 2-arylquinolines via palladium-catalysed C–H activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42588-42593
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05924K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nuno Viduedo, Leonardo Pirvu, Ângelo Alves, Fábio Santos, M. Manuel B. Marques
A mild, palladium-catalyzed C–H activation enables direct, sustainable synthesis of 2-arylquinolines from simple allyl amines, with up to 64% yield; green chemistry metrics highlight its superior atom economy and reduced environmental impact.
